NATO_ACTIVE.name: NATO Active
NATO_ACTIVE.description: USSR cannot Coup, Realign or Brush War in US-controlled countries in Europe.

NATO_CANCELED_WEST_GERMANY.name: NATO (W. Germany Excluded)
NATO_CANCELED_WEST_GERMANY.description: NATO no longer protects West Germany (canceled by Tear Down This Wall).

MARSHALL_PLAN_PLAYED.name: Marshall Plan Played
MARSHALL_PLAN_PLAYED.description: Prerequisite fulfilled for US to activate NATO.

WARSAW_PACT_PLAYED.name: Warsaw Pact Played
WARSAW_PACT_PLAYED.description: Prerequisite fulfilled for US to activate NATO.

US_JAPAN_PACT_ACTIVE.name: US/Japan Defense Pact
US_JAPAN_PACT_ACTIVE.description: USSR cannot Coup or Realign in Japan.

CONTAINMENT_ACTIVE.name: Containment Active
CONTAINMENT_ACTIVE.description: All US Operations receive +1 Op this turn (capped at 4 Ops).

PURGE_US_ACTIVE.name: Red Scare (US)
PURGE_US_ACTIVE.description: All US Operations receive -1 Op this turn (minimum 1 Op).

PURGE_USSR_ACTIVE.name: Purge (USSR)
PURGE_USSR_ACTIVE.description: All USSR Operations receive -1 Op this turn (minimum 1 Op).

VIETNAM_REVOLTS_ACTIVE.name: Vietnam Revolts
VIETNAM_REVOLTS_ACTIVE.description: This turn, a USSR card whose Operations are all spent in Southeast Asia gets +1 Op.

FORMOSAN_RESOLUTION_ACTIVE.name: Formosan Resolution
FORMOSAN_RESOLUTION_ACTIVE.description: While US-controlled, Taiwan is a Battleground country for Asia Scoring and Final Scoring; canceled when the US plays the China Card.

CMC_ACTIVE_US.name: Cuban Missile Crisis (played by US)
CMC_ACTIVE_US.description: A USSR Coup loses the game this turn, unless the USSR cancels the crisis by removing 2 influence from Cuba.

CMC_ACTIVE_USSR.name: Cuban Missile Crisis (played by USSR)
CMC_ACTIVE_USSR.description: A US Coup loses the game this turn, unless the US cancels the crisis by removing 2 influence from West Germany or Turkey.

NUCLEAR_SUBS_ACTIVE.name: Nuclear Subs Active
NUCLEAR_SUBS_ACTIVE.description: US Coup Attempts in battleground countries do not degrade DEFCON this turn.

QUAGMIRE_ACTIVE.name: Quagmire Active
QUAGMIRE_ACTIVE.description: Each Action Round the US must discard a 2+ Ops card and roll 1-4 to escape.

BEAR_TRAP_ACTIVE.name: Bear Trap Active
BEAR_TRAP_ACTIVE.description: Each Action Round the USSR must discard a 2+ Ops card and roll 1-4 to escape.

SALT_ACTIVE.name: SALT Negotiations
SALT_ACTIVE.description: All Coup Attempts by both players suffer -1 to die rolls for remainder of turn.

WE_WILL_BURY_YOU_PENDING.name: We Will Bury You (Pending)
WE_WILL_BURY_YOU_PENDING.description: USSR gains 3 VP at the start of the US's next Action Round unless the US plays UN Intervention as an Event in it.

BREZHNEV_DOCTRINE_ACTIVE.name: Brezhnev Doctrine
BREZHNEV_DOCTRINE_ACTIVE.description: All USSR Operations receive +1 Op this turn (capped at 4 Ops).

FLOWER_POWER_ACTIVE.name: Flower Power Active
FLOWER_POWER_ACTIVE.description: USSR gains 2 VP for each War card the US plays, as an Event or for Operations (canceled by An Evil Empire).

U2_INCIDENT_ACTIVE.name: U-2 Incident
U2_INCIDENT_ACTIVE.description: USSR gains 1 VP immediately; +1 additional VP if UN Intervention played this turn.

SHUTTLE_DIPLOMACY_ACTIVE.name: Shuttle Diplomacy
SHUTTLE_DIPLOMACY_ACTIVE.description: Subtracts 1 USSR Battleground from next Asia or Middle East Scoring (not Final Scoring).

DEATH_SQUADS_US.name: Latin American Death Squads (US)
DEATH_SQUADS_US.description: This turn, US Coup rolls in Central and South America get +1 and USSR Coup rolls there get -1.

DEATH_SQUADS_USSR.name: Latin American Death Squads (USSR)
DEATH_SQUADS_USSR.description: This turn, USSR Coup rolls in Central and South America get +1 and US Coup rolls there get -1.

CAMP_DAVID_PLAYED.name: Camp David Accords
CAMP_DAVID_PLAYED.description: Prevents Arab-Israeli War from being played as an Event.

IRON_LADY_PLAYED.name: The Iron Lady
IRON_LADY_PLAYED.description: Prevents #7 Socialist Governments from being played as an Event.

NORTH_SEA_OIL_PLAYED.name: North Sea Oil Played
NORTH_SEA_OIL_PLAYED.description: Prevents #61 OPEC from being played as an Event.

NORTH_SEA_OIL_ACTIVE.name: North Sea Oil
NORTH_SEA_OIL_ACTIVE.description: Grants US an 8th Action Round for the current turn only.

THE_REFORMER_PLAYED.name: The Reformer
THE_REFORMER_PLAYED.description: USSR can no longer Coup in Europe. #90 Glasnost's Event also grants 4 Ops for Influence or Realignment.

IRAN_CONTRA_ACTIVE.name: Iran-Contra Scandal
IRAN_CONTRA_ACTIVE.description: All US Realignment rolls receive -1 to their die roll for remainder of turn.

EVIL_EMPIRE_PLAYED.name: An Evil Empire
EVIL_EMPIRE_PLAYED.description: Cancels and prevents the effects of #59 Flower Power.

ALDRICH_AMES_ACTIVE.name: Aldrich Ames Remix
ALDRICH_AMES_ACTIVE.description: US hand of cards remains revealed face-up to USSR for remainder of turn.

JOHN_PAUL_II_PLAYED.name: John Paul II Elected Pope
JOHN_PAUL_II_PLAYED.description: Prerequisite fulfilled enabling #101 Solidarity to be played as an Event.

NORAD_ACTIVE.name: NORAD Active
NORAD_ACTIVE.description: If DEFCON moves to 2 during an Action Round and Canada is US-controlled, the US adds 1 Influence to a country with US Influence (canceled by Quagmire).

YURI_AND_SAMANTHA_ACTIVE.name: Yuri and Samantha
YURI_AND_SAMANTHA_ACTIVE.description: USSR gains 1 VP for each US Coup Attempt performed during remainder of turn.

AWACS_PLAYED.name: AWACS Sale to Saudis
AWACS_PLAYED.description: Prevents #56 Muslim Revolution from being played as an Event.

IRANIAN_HOSTAGE_CRISIS_PLAY.name: Iranian Hostage Crisis
IRANIAN_HOSTAGE_CRISIS_PLAY.description: Forces US to randomly discard 2 cards instead of 1 when #92 Terrorism is played.

WILLY_BRANDT_PLAYED.name: Willy Brandt Played
WILLY_BRANDT_PLAYED.description: Cancels NATO for West Germany (canceled by Tear Down This Wall).

TEAR_DOWN_THIS_WALL_PLAYED.name: Tear Down this Wall
TEAR_DOWN_THIS_WALL_PLAYED.description: Cancels and prevents the effects of #55 Willy Brandt.

CHERNOBYL_ACTIVE.name: Chernobyl Active
CHERNOBYL_ACTIVE.description: USSR cannot add Influence using Operations points in the forbidden region this turn.
